heading: Merger of similar associations

tree.heading: In general
tree.text: Associations may voluntarily merge with other like associations if the plan of merger is approved by—

children.text: the respective Boards of Directors of the associations involved;
a majority vote of the stockholders of each association voting, in person or by proxy, at a duly authorized stockholders’ meeting; and

tree.heading: Procedures
tree.text: The provisions of subsections (b) and (c) of section 2279c–1 of this title shall apply to associations merged under this section.

notes.text: Amendments1988—Subsec. (a)(4). Pub. L. 100–399, § 408(s), substituted “the Farm Credit Banks involved” for “the Farm Credit Bank”. Subsec. (b). Pub. L. 100–399, § 408(t), substituted “subsections (b) and (c)” for “subsections (b), (c), and (d)”.

Effective Date of 1988 AmendmentAmendment by Pub. L. 100–399 effective as if enacted immediately after enactment of Pub. L. 100–233, which was approved Jan. 6, 1988, see section 1001(a) of Pub. L. 100–399, set out as a note under section 2002 of this title.
